name: recorded-unauthorized
description: RECORDED against production 2026-10-10 with `deno task record`, then hand-minimized per fixture strategy v2. Headers are never captured, so no credential can be in here. Trace id zeroed. A real 401, produced by recording with a deliberately invalid key. The refusal keeps `error_code` and `docs_url`, which is how an agent recovers: fetch docs_url with .md added ahead of the fragment. The url binds, so this one chain serves every endpoint, all seven being POST, and the engine zero-bills it.
